verdict.rationale: Belvo's own docs center data access on a single persistent 'link' object. Developers filter List requests by link.id across resources (belvo-docs-13), and recurrent links refresh 'information' weekly with webhook notification (belvo-docs-26). Post-link-creation retrieval of core link data and async POST calls work on that same link (belvo-docs-10, belvo-docs-11), while Brazil aggregation covers transactions, balances and investments (belvo-docs-1). Together these imply one connection feeds several data resources, but no doc states it outright. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that a single Connect Widget session unlocks multiple products without re-consent, evidence that identity/owner data comes from the same link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
